system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: *Context*: Skill metadata (name, description, location) is injected into the system prompt.
system_prompt_style.note: Also AGENTS.md project instructions read; blueprints can set system message.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Ellama reads project instructions from ~AGENTS.md~, can load reusable skills and blueprint prompts, and runs plan-and-act loops or subagents from the task tool.
env_context_strategy.note: Skill metadata/context injection plus tool-driven navigation (read_file, grep, directory_tree).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Compaction summarizes older conversation turns into one synthetic assistant message and keeps the most recent user turns verbatim.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The built-in ~read_file~ tool supports image and audio files through a configurable read mode

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Models or providers that cannot call tools can still participate by emitting the fallback ~BEGIN_ELLAMA_AGENT_STATE~ block described in the controller prompt.
tool_call_format.note: Default is provider tool calls via llm package; fallback text block for non-tool models.

tool_count.note: README lists many tools (read_file, write_file, append_file, prepend_file, edit_file, directory_tree, move_file, count_lines, lines_range, grep, grep_in_file, shell_command, task, task_from_template, ask_user) but no authoritative default-enabled count; tools are disabled/enabled by name.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Projects can define shell commands that run around mutating edit tools: ~write_file~, ~append_file~, ~prepend_file~ and ~edit_file~.
edit_primitive.note: edit_file inferred as search/replace-style edit; write_file is full content.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Use MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools with ~ellama~. Requires Emacs 30+ and the ~mcp.el~ package
tool_schema_source.note: Built-in tools defined in Elisp via ellama-tools-define-tool with hand-written descriptions.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: When ~:categoryp t~ is used, Ellama derives a stable MCP tool identity as ~<category>/<tool-name>~

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: ~ellama-plan-and-act~: Start an agent loop that first creates a checklist plan and then acts on it with automatic continuations.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Plan-and-act state is stored in the session extra data, so the loop survives session compaction and regular session persistence.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Ellama provides two tools for delegating work to an asynchronous sub-agent.
multi_agent_topology.note: Default chat/agent is a single agent; orchestrator_workers reachable when task tool enabled with configured roles.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each sub-agent runs in its own Ellama session.
delegation_mechanism.note: Requires enabling the task tool and subagent roles.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: ~ellama-tools-allow-all~: Allow ~ellama~ using all the tools without user confirmation. Dangerous. Use at your own risk.
human_in_loop.note: Default: per-call confirmation unless tool is in ellama-tools-allowed.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Plan-and-act state is stored in the session extra data
short_term_state.note: Plain chat is conversation-only; agent loop keeps checklist state.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Agent Skills provide instructions and supporting files for specific tasks.
long_term_memory.note: file_notes: AGENTS.md project instructions and blueprint files read across runs.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Chat sessions can be saved, resumed, renamed, compacted manually, or compacted automatically

self_verification.evidence_quote: ~ellama-tools-dlp-llm-check-enabled~: Enable the optional isolated LLM safety classifier (disabled by default).
self_verification.note: Also edit-hook shell commands can run tests/linters if configured; off by default.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Any successful sub-agent response resets the consecutive error counter.
retry_policy.note: Only request-error continuation, no task-level retry policy described.

rollback.evidence_quote: After hooks run after a successful write; failure is reported to the agent and does not roll back the edit.
rollback.note: ellama-undo-on-error undoes partial buffer insertion on LLM error, disabled by default.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: continues automatically through the checklist until the agent reports a result, marks the plan complete, becomes blocked, or reaches ~ellama-tools-agent-default-max-steps~

cost_controls.evidence_quote: ~ellama-max-tokens~: Maximum number of tokens to generate. If not set, use the provider default.
cost_controls.note: Also per-task providers (coding/summarization/extraction) select different models.

timeouts.evidence_quote: ~ellama-tools-shell-command-default-timeout~: Default timeout for shell command execution.
timeouts.evidence_locator: README.org Tool Prompts and Edit Behavior

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: ~ellama-tools-use-srt~: Run shell-based tools (~shell_command~, ~grep~ and ~grep_in_file~) via the external ~srt~ sandbox runtime. Disabled by default.
execution_isolation.note: Default runs inside Emacs on the host; shell tools are host subprocesses. srt sandbox is opt-in.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: reads are allowed by default and writes are denied unless allowed by ~allowWrite~
filesystem_access.evidence_locator: README.org SRT Filesystem Policy for Tools
filesystem_access.note: Without srt enabled, file tools access the host filesystem unrestricted; scoped when srt policy is configured.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Local checks intentionally ignore unrelated ~srt~ keys (for example ~network.*~).
network_policy.evidence_locator: README.org SRT Filesystem Policy for Tools
network_policy.note: Network allowlist only via opt-in srt settings; default no restriction.

permission_model.evidence_quote: ~ellama-tools-allowed~: List of allowed ~ellama~ tools. Tools from this list will work without user confirmation.
permission_model.note: Default confirmation per call; static allowlist and DLP/irreversible policy engine also available.

tracing.evidence_quote: ~ellama-tools-dlp-audit-log-file~: JSONL path used when ~file~ sink is enabled.
tracing.note: Also ellama-debug buffer logging; sessions saved to files.

replayability.note: Sessions can be reloaded and continued; no deterministic replay.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: ~ellama-eval-default-max-steps~: Default maximum number of steps in eval loop.
eval_hooks.note: An eval loop with workspaces exists in the repo; not a named public benchmark runner.

guardrails.note: output redact/block; irreversible-action blocking and srt filesystem checks.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Ellama brings large language models into Emacs without turning Emacs into a web app.
target_domain.note: Agentic coding setup plus generic MCP tools.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: It uses the [[https://elpa.gnu.org/packages/llm.html][llm]] package, so Ollama works with a local model, and the same Ellama commands can be configured for OpenAI-compatible APIs, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Vertex
